findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.untrusted_source: rec1->name and rec2->name, rec1->surname and rec2->surname
findings.trigger: If the input strings exceed the buffer size (15 for name, 25 for surname)
findings.assumptions: The input data (rec1->name, rec1->surname, rec2->name, rec2->surname) is not sanitized or validated before being passed to strcmp.
